/.title: Postictal — Neurological Recovery
/.description: Postictal uses smartphone-based digital biomarkers to quantify how neurological function returns to baseline.
h2: Recovery, all the way back to baseline.
Help build the science of neurological recovery.
p: Building a platform to track neurological recovery following seizure events, powered by smartphone-derived biomarkers.
In about ninety seconds, the phone captures structured measurements across the neurological systems a seizure disrupts.
Facial landmark mapping and micro-expression tracking.
Saccade velocity, fixation stability, and pupil response.
Articulation, fluency, and response timing analysis.
Response latency and cognitive processing speed.
Every captured signal streams into the NeuroCheck™ Engine, where it is modeled into a structured recovery index.
Hundreds of signals are analyzed and composed into a single recovery index — the NRI™ — designed to track how recovery progresses over time.
Repeat scans chart the Return-to-Baseline curve over days and weeks — longitudinal, reproducible, and designed for clinical research contexts.
We are currently enrolling healthy volunteers for the POSTICTAL-HC1 study. Join us in developing reliable tools for neurological recovery research.
Postictal is a research-stage prototype and is not a medical device.
